[IDENTITY LOCK]
Create image: use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision. Preserve recognizable identity, exact facial proportions, natural asymmetry, authentic facial character, smooth light-toned East Asian skin with natural satin radiance and subtle warmth across the cheeks.

[VISUAL CONTEXT :: LINHAGEM E REGISTRO]
primary_lineage: Lifestyle / candid-performático
direction_spectrum_score: 4
vocabulary_register:
required_terms: staged-spontaneity, unguarded, light-as-protagonist, effortless
forbidden_terms: rigid, choreographed, studio-precision, controlled
All descriptive language in this prompt is governed by this register — required terms must appear; forbidden terms are categorically excluded.

[SUBJECT :: CORPO E EXPRESSÃO]
An athletic young East Asian woman with an infectious, beaming smile in an atmosphere of staged-spontaneity. Her expression is wide and enthusiastic, showing an open smile with visible upper teeth, slight cheek crinkling around the eyes, and a relaxed jawline behind thin-framed round wire glasses. She wears a casual, sporty ensemble featuring a cropped light heather-grey zip-up hoodie displaying graphic rectangular patch prints along the sleeves and chest, left slightly unzipped at the hem to expose the midriff and a discreet navel piercing. Her lower body is styled in micro-length denim cutoff shorts secured with an embellished grommet belt and draped silver chain accents hanging loosely along the hip, paired with thick white slouch socks.

[BODY MECHANICS :: ANATOMIA INDEPENDENTE]
The subject is seated on the floor in an effortless, dynamic recline. Weight distribution rests firmly on her right hip and the palm of her right arm, which is extended back against the carpeted floor for support. Her torso shows a natural ribcage tilt with lumbar extension, counter-balancing the hips. Her left arm is raised freely upward with an acute bend at the elbow, her left hand forming a classic peace/V-sign near her forehead with index and middle fingers cleanly separated while thumb and remaining fingers curl naturally. Her legs rest together to her right side with knees bent sharply, thigh and calf musculature compressed realistically against the floor plane. Her head tilts gently toward her right shoulder with relaxed cervical muscle engagement.
Avoid: mannequin symmetry, stiff spine alignment, fused fingers, distorted wrist angles, unnatural leg proportions, misaligned shoulder joints.

[SURFACE :: CABELO, PELE E MAQUIAGEM]
Hair is deep natural black, parted centrally into two low twin ponytails resting over the shoulders, accompanied by soft, straight front bangs feathering across the forehead and wispy tendrils framing the jawline. Skin has a natural, healthy dewy finish with subtle texture, pore visibility, and authentic facial tone without artificial blurring. Makeup is minimal and fresh: subtle pink blush washed over the apples of the cheeks, defined soft dark eyeliner, and a glossy tinted lip finish.

[OBJECTS / SPACE :: AMBIENTE E INVENTÁRIO]
The setting conveys unguarded domestic warmth within a spacious modern living room. Foreground is grounded by a thick cream-colored low-pile carpet with undulating ribbed textural patterns. The background features a low wooden credenza with a mounted wide flat-screen display cast in a subtle ambient magenta backlight glow, hexagonal wall light panels on the left, a tall arched mirror, vertical fluted wood slat wall paneling, and a low wooden coffee table holding insulated tumblers and bottles.
atmosphere: casual contemporary living space with an effortless social media aesthetic.
materials: plush loop wool rug, light oak veneer, brushed metal accessories, weathered denim, soft cotton fleece.

[LIGHT & OPTICS :: ILUMINAÇÃO E ASSINATURA TÉCNICA]
Natural and mixed interior lighting acts with light-as-protagonist, combining diffuse warm overhead architectural lighting with a soft frontal bounce that evenly illuminates the subject's face and torso. A secondary purple-magenta LED wash emanates from behind the background television screen, offering subtle rim separation. Camera signature mimics a high-end smartphone wide-angle lens with minimal barrel distortion, capturing crisp foreground detail with gentle organic focus falloff toward the background.
lens: smartphone wide-angle equivalent 24mm f/1.8
white_balance: balanced warm indoor interior (~3400K) with cool ambient room accents.

[COLOR GRADE :: MATIZ E CONTRASTE]
temperature: warm neutral with golden undertones and subtle magenta ambient accents in the shadows.
saturation: moderate, editorial-balanced with vivid skin tones and authentic blue denim.
contrast: balanced with soft roll-off in the highlights.
shadows: open, lifted slightly with warm neutral tones.
highlights: soft, preserving fabric textures and natural skin specular highlights without harsh clipping.
color_science_connotation: modern flagship smartphone high-fidelity sensor rendering.

[COMPOSITION :: ENQUADRAMENTO E PROFUNDIDADE]
framing: full seated figure captured from a slightly elevated eye-level angle looking downward toward the floor.
point_of_view: intimate, close perspective creating dynamic depth between the foreground legs and background interior.
foreground_elements: textured cream rug fibers leading into the lower leg and hip.
background: living room furniture and architectural elements softly resolved in mid-to-deep focus.
depth_of_field: moderate depth of field with sharp subject isolation and soft background separation.

[ANATOMICAL REINFORCEMENT :: CHECKLIST DE CORREÇÃO]
Ensure: correct shoulder girdle positioning supporting asymmetric arm elevations; authentic thoracic and lumbar spinal curvature during floor recline; anatomically accurate finger separation on the peace sign gesture; natural weight compression on the resting thigh and hand; authentic facial feature symmetry and realistic dental articulation.

[NEGATIVE PROMPT :: EXCLUSÕES DINÂMICAS]
rigid posture, choreographed pose, studio-precision lighting, controlled studio environment, plastic airbrushed skin, smoothed pores, artificial face filter, extra fingers, fused digits, deformed hands, broken wrist, distorted anatomy, floating limbs, unnatural joint angles, harsh flash glare, clipped highlights, deep crushed shadows, visible digital watermarks, logos, text overlays.

 # 📸 High-Resolution Portrait of Woman with Acne in Sophisticated São Paulo Bathroom
**Prompt Description:**
Generate a photorealistic, high-resolution portrait based on `image_0.png`. A 32-year-old woman, inspired by the person in the reference image but clearly aged, is looking into a large, framed mirror in a sophisticated, high-end bathroom. Her expression is similar to `image_0.png`, full of concern and introspection, as she holds her chin.
**Key Visual Details:**
* **Subject:** A 32-year-old Brazilian woman with a similar hair style and expression to the reference, but with visible signs of adult acne. Her skin is realistic, showing active, inflamed blemishes (red papules and pustules) primarily on her cheeks and chin. Her face also shows more natural skin texture appropriate for her age, like very subtle crow's feet and other texture details, along with the freckles seen in `image_0.png`.
* **A Sophisticated Bathroom:** The setting should be significantly more luxurious than the white subway tiles in `image_0.png`. It should feature:
 * Carrara marble walls and countertops with elegant grey veining.
 * Polished brass or gold fixtures, including the faucet and mirror frame.
 * A large, clean mirror with a subtle, warm-toned backlighting.
 * Upmarket toiletries in cohesive, minimalist packaging (not just a wooden shelf with basic items).
 * Perhaps a piece of contemporary art visible in the background.
* **Composition:** A over-the-shoulder shot from behind the woman, looking into the mirror, clearly showing her face in the reflection with the detailed acne texture and worried expression. The reflection of the entire high-end bathroom must be visible.
* **Lighting:** Soft, warm, and natural light mixed with well-integrated architectural lighting. A window (similar position to `image_0.png`) lets in natural São Paulo daylight, casting a soft glow.
* **Camera:** Shot on a full-frame DSLR (e.g., Sony A9, Canon R5) with a shallow depth of field (shallow DoF), focusing sharply on the woman's face and her reflection. 8k resolution, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
**Location Metadata for an Upscale São Paulo Neighborhood:**
* **City:** São Paulo, SP, Brazil
* **Neighborhood:** Jardins / Jardim Paulista
* **Street:** Rua Estados Unidos (near Parque Ibirapuera)
* **Context:** A high-end, luxury apartment building.
**Style and Realism:** The image should be a hyper-realistic photograph, indistinguishable from a real-life candid shot. Focus on the raw texture of her skin and the polished textures of the luxury bathroom elements. The contrast between her natural skin issues and the perfect luxury environment should be a central theme. The style must avoid any "glamour filter" look, embracing realism.

STUDIO EDITORIAL — SINGLE SHOT v3 (EXPRESSIVE)

INPUT A (model image): [attach]
INPUT B (clothing image): [attach]
POSE DIRECTION: fashion portrait{

  },
  "camera_technical": {
    "angle": "High-angle shot, looking down from stairs",
    "look": "Shot-on-phone, natural outdoor lighting, wide depth of field, sharp focus from subject to background, ",
    "imperfections": ["harsh natural shadows", "non-studio lighting", "natural skin texture", "grainy texture in shadow areas"]
  },
  "scene_description": {
    "environment": "Rustic outdoor resort setting, weathered wooden stairs leading down to a white gravel area, turquoise pool and sun loungers in the soft-focus background",
 
    "elements": ["wooden railings", "bamboo stalks to the left", "rustic sunbeds with green towels"]
  },
  "subject_details": {
    },
    "pose": "Walking up wooden stairs, left hand resting on a rustic wooden railing, looking slightly towards the camera with a relaxed expression"
  },
, jaqueta em cima do ombro, against a blue to white gradient backdrop, creating a fashion and moody atmosphere, nature light, high-contrast --profile spc2tb2
---

STEP 1 — VISUAL EXTRACTION (internal, do not output):

From INPUT A — Model:
Extract: skin tone value (light / medium / tan / deep),
skin undertone (warm / cool / neutral), body proportions,
hair color and texture, facial structure.

From INPUT B — Clothing:
Extract: clothing value (light / medium / dark), dominant
color temperature (warm / cool / neutral), fabric weight
and surface language (matte, glossy, washed, fluid,
structured, raw), silhouette category, styling signals,
cultural or subcultural coding of the look.

---

STEP 2 — BACKGROUND SELECTION (internal):
FIXED: gradient sky backdrop — a smooth, luminous gradient
that transitions from a saturated cerulean or sky blue
at the top to a softer, lighter powder blue or near-white
at the horizon zone. Think open sky at midday — vivid
but not neon, atmospheric but not hazy.
The gradient is seamless and continuous — no clouds,
no texture, no horizon line, no ground plane visible.
Pure tonal transition from deep sky blue (top) to
pale icy blue or blue-white (bottom). The background
reads as infinite atmospheric depth.
Lighting must be consistent with the sky backdrop —
cool-neutral white balance (6000–6500K) to harmonize
with the blue tones. Key light simulates a high
directional sun or large diffused sky source.
Shadow edges are soft but defined. No warm gels.
No studio box feel — the light should feel like
filtered open sky.
Rim or separation light acceptable and encouraged —
the subject must read clearly against the blue field.


---

STEP 3 — POSE & CAMERA SELECTION (internal):

PHILOSOPHY:
The pose must feel like a decision, not a default.
Prioritize tension, attitude, and physical presence over
elegance or symmetry. The model owns the frame.
Think editorial confrontation, not commercial compliance.

If POSE DIRECTION is specified: follow it faithfully
but interpret with maximum personality.

If free: choose the pose that makes the clothing feel
like a statement, not a product.

---

POSE REPERTOIRE — EXPRESSIVE EDITION:

CONFRONTATIONAL / POWER POSES:
  — Crouched low, weight on heels, knees apart, chest
    forward, gaze straight into lens. Camera at knee
    level or below — shooting up. Creates dominance.
  — Standing, feet planted wide, one arm extended or
    reaching toward camera. Body forward, chin slightly
    down. Low angle. Intentional aggression.
  — Arms raised — one or both — hands framing face,
    touching hair or nape. Torso twist. Direct gaze.
    Eye-level or slight low angle.

FLOOR / GROUND POSES:
  — Lying on side, body diagonal across frame, head
    propped on one hand. Other hand resting on hip or
    waist. Gaze direct or deliberately away.
    Slight high angle — creates compression and intimacy.
  — Seated on floor, one knee pulled to chest, one leg
    extended. Spine straight. Arms wrapped around knee
    or one hand on the floor. Eye level or slight high.
  — On hands and knees, body parallel to floor, face
    turned hard toward camera. Low angle, wide-ish.
    Raw, animalistic energy.
  — Back arched, weight on one hip on the floor,
    legs folded to one side, one arm extended behind
    for support. Gaze upward or into lens.
    High angle, slightly overhead.

CLOSE-UP / FRAGMENT POSES:
  — Extreme close-up: face and upper chest only.
    Face at angle — strong jaw line or pure profile.
    One hand visible — at collar, jaw, or glasses.
    85–105mm aesthetic. Shallow depth of field.
    Background nearly blown into smooth glow.
  — Mid-shot: waist to top of head. Body in slight
    torso twist, shoulder toward camera. Hands active —
    one in hair, one at waistband, holding fabric edge.
    Direct or averted gaze with intention.
  — Fragment close-up: thigh to crown. Clothing detail
    and face share the frame. One hand doing something
    specific — gripping, adjusting, touching.

MOVEMENT-IMPLIED POSES:
  — Mid-stride, one foot forward, one back. Arms not
    symmetric — one bent, one extending. Face turned
    toward camera mid-movement. Eye level.
  — Jump cut energy: body caught in a pivot — torso
    one direction, face another. Weight visibly shifting.
    Slight motion blur on non-focal elements is acceptable.
  — Hair mid-movement (thrown or falling). Body still
    but hair in motion. Creates energy without losing
    clothing detail.

CAMERA ANGLE — EXPANDED FREEDOM:

  — Ultra-low angle (camera at floor level, shooting
    steeply up): use for crouched, confrontational, or
    standing power poses. Makes subject monumental.
  — Low angle (camera below hip, shooting up):
    standard power framing.
  — Eye level neutral: standing and mid poses.
  — Slight high angle (just above eye, shooting down):
    floor poses, seated. Intimacy and compression.
  — Overhead / near-bird (camera directly above or
    45° steep): use sparingly for floor poses where
    the body creates a strong graphic shape.
  — Pushed-in with slight wide distortion (35–50mm
    aesthetic): use for confrontational close-ups where
    the lens pressure adds tension. Only for face/
    upper-body fragments — never for full-body (avoids
    proportion distortion).

CAMERA ANGLE must amplify the pose's intention.
Never choose a neutral angle by default. Ask: does
this angle make the image stronger or weaker?

---

STEP 4 — FINAL IMAGE OUTPUT:

Generate a single, high-resolution studio editorial
photograph. One pose. One frame. Not a grid. Not a
composite. Not a contact sheet.

SUBJECT: exact model from INPUT A wearing exact garments
from INPUT B. Preserve all of: skin tone, face, body
proportions, hair, and every clothing detail — color,
texture, stitching, hardware, logo placement.

POSE: as selected in Step 3. Committed, intentional,
editorial. Not neutral, not catalog. The model has
attitude — the pose communicates it.

BACKGROUND: seamless warm off-white infinity curve.
No props, no furniture, no texture on backdrop.
Floor and wall are one unbroken surface.

FORMAT: portrait orientation (4:5 or 2:3 preferred).
Full bleed. No border, no text, no watermark, no frame.

LIGHTING: directional soft-box studio light — one key
source at 30–45°, with controlled fill ratio (1:2 to 1:3)
to preserve shadow detail on fabric and skin. The
light should sculpt the subject against the white bg —
not flatten them into it. Neutral white balance 5500K.
No colored gels. No ring light. Shadow must define volume.
Rim light or subtle separation light acceptable when pose
creates risk of subject merging with white background.

QUALITY MARKERS:
— Realistic skin micro-texture, pores, natural moisture,
  subsurface scattering. No airbrushing, no smoothing.
— Faithful fabric reproduction: satin sheen, wool nap,
  leather grain, chiffon translucency, denim weave —
  exactly as in INPUT B. No color shift, no detail loss.
— Natural hair texture and movement from INPUT A.
— Clothing fits and drapes realistically on the body.
— Gaze: direct, semi-direct, or deliberately averted
  with intention. Never commercial-catalog expression,
  never forced smile. Attitude, not pleasantness.
— Hands and feet in frame must be anatomically precise.

CAMERA: 85mm lens aesthetic as default. 35–50mm for
pushed-in confrontational close-ups. Depth of field
calibrated to pose — shallow for close-up fragments,
medium-deep for full body. Subtle natural grain.
No over-sharpening, no fake HDR, no preset color grading.

AESTHETIC REFERENCE: Vogue Italia editorial, System
Magazine, Acne Paper, i-D, CR Fashion Book.
Restrained but charged. Precise and bodily.
Not commercial. Not catalog. Not influencer.

---

STRICT NEGATIVES:
multiple panels, composite grid, flat lay, mannequin,
pure white #fff backdrop (warm off-white only), black
backdrop, chromatic colored backdrop, altered face or
skin tone, changed body proportions, changed clothing
colors or texture, logo modification, airbrushed skin,
plastic texture finish, 3D render feel, cartoon aesthetic,
neon glow, fake HDR, ring-light halo, catalog pose,
commercial retail expression, forced smile, oversaturated,
heavy vignette, watermark, text overlay, lifeless
neutral standing pose, symmetrical arms-at-sides stance,
hands invisible or hidden, dead gaze, straight-on flat
camera angle with no intention.

items.rawPrompt:
Analisando as fotos que você enviou, percebo uma estética bucólica, romântica e etérea . A luz filtrada pelas folhas cria uma textura orgânica maravilhosa, e o balanço serve como uma "âncora" narrativa perfeita.
 Para elevar esse ensaio do "bonito" para o " editorial narrativo ", vamos transformar o jardim em um personagem e a modelo em uma viajante do tempo ou uma ninfa urbana.
 Aqui está o briefing detalhado para 10 fotos com ângulos e direções distintas:
 📖 O Conceito: "O Sussurro da Clorofila" 
 Narrativa: A história de uma mulher que reencontra sua essência em um jardim esquecido. As fotos evoluem da timidez/esconderijo para a total entrega à natureza.
 1. O Frame de Abertura (Plano Detalhe/Macro) 
 Ângulo: Macro, foco seletivo. 
 Composição: A mão da modelo tocando delicadamente uma folha orvalhada ou uma pétala. O rosto dela aparece ao fundo, completamente desfocado (bokeh). 
 Direção: "Sinta a textura da planta como se estivesse lendo braile. Respire fundo, olhos fechados." 
 Efeito: Estabelece a conexão sensorial imediata com o ambiente. 
 2. A Observadora Escondida (Frame within a Frame) 
 Ângulo: Plano Médio, câmera posicionada "dentro" de um arbusto. 
 Composição: Use as folhas verdes em primeiro plano para criar uma moldura natural ao redor do rosto dela. 
 Direção: "Olhe através da folhagem como se estivesse observando algo secreto. Um olhar curioso, mas calmo." 
 Efeito: Cria uma sensação de voyeurismo poético e profundidade de campo. 
 3. A Ascensão no Balanço (Ângulo Baixo / Contra-Plongée) 
 Ângulo: Câmera quase no chão, apontando para cima. 
 Composição: A modelo sentada no balanço, mas o ângulo baixo faz com que ela pareça estar flutuando contra as copas das árvores e o céu. 
 Direção: "Incline a cabeça para trás, estique as pontas dos pés. Deixe o braço cair relaxado." 
 Efeito: Transmite poder e uma sensação de liberdade divina (estilo editorial Vogue Italia ). 
 4. O Banho de Sol (Zenital / High Angle) 
 Ângulo: Completamente de cima para baixo. 
 Composição: Modelo deitada na grama ou sentada no chão entre flores. O vestido branco deve se espalhar como uma mancha de luz no verde. 
 Direção: "Imagine que o sol é uma carícia. Espalhe o cabelo de forma orgânica na terra." 
 Efeito: Explora padrões geométricos e a vulnerabilidade da modelo. 
 5. Silhueta de Luz (Rim Light / Contra-Luz) 
 Ângulo: Perfil lateral, com o sol exatamente atrás da modelo. 
 Composição: O sol cria uma linha de luz (rim light) no contorno do corpo e nos fios de cabelo. 
 Direção: "Não olhe para a lente. Olhe para o horizonte. Mantenha o queixo levemente erguido." 
 Efeito: Dá um ar angelical e místico, transformando o corpo em forma pura. 
 6. Movimento Etéreo (Longa Exposição/Panning) 
 Ângulo: Plano Aberto. 
 Composição: Modelo girando ou correndo suavemente entre as plantas. 
 Direção: "Brinque com o tecido do vestido. Esqueça a câmera, apenas dance com o vento." 
 Técnica: Use uma velocidade de obturador levemente mais lenta (ex: 1/40s) para capturar o rastro do movimento. 
 Efeito: Traz dinamismo e a ideia de que o tempo no jardim corre de forma diferente. 
 7. O Reflexo Narcisista (Se houver água ou uso de espelho) 
 Ângulo: Ângulo oblíquo. 
 Composição: Use um pequeno espelho de mão quebrado ou um pedaço de vidro entre as flores para refletir apenas o olhar dela. 
 Direção: "Olhe para o seu reflexo como se estivesse vendo outra pessoa. Reconheça-se." 
 Efeito: Adiciona uma camada surrealista e psicológica à narrativa. 
 8. A Fusão com o Tronco (Textura e Contraste) 
 Ângulo: Plano Médio Cerrado. 
 Composição: A modelo encostada no tronco de uma árvore antiga e rugosa. O contraste da pele suave com a casca bruta da árvore. 
 Direção: "Abrace a árvore de costas. Sinta o suporte dela. Ombros relaxados, respiração pela boca (lábios entreabertos)." 
 Efeito: Simboliza força e aterramento. 
 9. A Despedida (Deep Depth of Field) 
 Ângulo: Plano Geral, ponto de fuga. 
 Composição: A modelo caminhando para longe da câmera, em direção a uma parte mais densa e escura do jardim. 
 Direção: "Caminhe devagar. Olhe por cima do ombro uma última vez, sem parar de andar." 
 Efeito: Cria melancolia e o fechamento do arco narrativo ("ela pertence ao jardim agora"). 
 10. O Retrato de Conclusão (Close-up Dramático) 
 Ângulo: Close-up frontal, nível dos olhos. 
 Composição: Foco absoluto na íris. Uma pequena folha ou pétala colada propositalmente na bochecha ou perto do olho. 
 Direção: "Agora, olhe diretamente para a lente. Sem sorriso. Apenas a verdade." 
 Efeito: Confronta o espectador e finaliza com uma conexão humana poderosa. 
 Dica Extra do VibePHOTO: No pós-processamento, tente manter os verdes levemente desbotados (tons de sálvia ou oliva) para não competirem com o tom de pele da modelo. Use uma leve camada de "Grain" (ruído) para dar uma textura de filme analógico, o que combina perfeitamente com cenários de jardim.
 Qual dessas ideias mais ressoa com a personalidade da sua modelo?

A large accent mirror with a carved frame stands against the wall, alongside a minimalist white ceramic vase.

 Roupas (Wardrobe): Substituí o visual rústico pelas roupas exatas da imagem de referência (T-shirt "LUCKY FLOWER", saia plissada xadrez azul, óculos roxos). 
 Cenário (Setting): Troquei o muro de pedra por um capitel de pilar grego (a parte superior da coluna), criando um contraste surreal/editorial. 
 Estética (Vibe): Mudei de "Rustic Vogue" para "Modern Y2K / Streetwear Editorial", ajustando a luz e a atitude para algo mais pop e vibrante. 
 POSITIVE PROMPT 
 Constraints: 
 Vertical (9:16), High-end fashion editorial photography, medium-full shot of a female model sitting on a Greek pillar in a bright outdoor setting. 
 Composition: 
 Low angle shot looking slightly up at the subject; subject is perched comfortably on top of a broken classical Greek column capital; legs are asymmetrical (one bent, one dangling); relaxed posture; gaze directed towards the camera with a cool, confident attitude. 
 Environment: 
 Outdoor surreal setting; bright clear blue sky background; direct, high-contrast sunlight (hard lighting); minimal shadows; clean architectural lines of the stone column contrasting with the sky. 
 Materials & textures: 
 T-shirt: Soft white cotton jersey texture, slight fabric folds around the waist; matte screen-print texture on the chest graphic. 
 Skirt: Woven fabric texture, crisp pleats, distinct tartan/plaid pattern in blues and white. 
 Pillar: Weathered marble texture, chips and cracks in the stone, rough porous surface contrasting with smooth skin. 
 Accessories: Glossy purple plastic of the sunglasses. 
 Primary focus (Y2K Fashion & Outfit Accuracy): 
 Top: White t-shirt featuring a colorful graphic with the text "LUCKY" (pink arched) and "FLOWER" (pink straight) surrounding a stylized abstract sun/flower motif in orange and blue. 
 Bottom: Blue plaid/tartan pleated mini-skirt with defined hem. 
 Accessory: Chunky purple rectangular sunglasses perched on top of the head (headband style). 
 Hair: Dark wavy hair (or subject's hair) with bangs styling. 
 Color & light: 
 High-key lighting; bright whites; saturated pop colors (pink, orange, blue from the outfit); cool daylight white balance; no sepia or rustic filters; "flash photography" aesthetic typical of Y2K editorials. 
 Camera behavior: 
 35mm lens simulation; sharp focus on the face and outfit texture; deep depth of field (sky is clear); fine digital grain; crisp edges; no motion blur. 
 Overall aesthetic: 
 Y2K modern aesthetic, Gen Z fashion editorial, playful, bold, streetwear meets classical architecture, vibrant and clean. 
 STRICT NEGATIVES 
 Rustic, cottagecore, sepia, warm vintage filter, drawing, 3d render, illustration, painting, blurry text, misspelled text, messy graphic, long dress, knitwear, straw hat, wheat, grass, forest, mud, dark lighting, low contrast, distorted face, extra fingers.

items.rawPrompt:
Com base na estética de high-end commercial luxury dos anos 90 presente na imagem de referência, aqui está o prompt otimizado para o Nano Banana Pro.
 Este prompt utiliza uma estrutura narrativa técnica para capturar a textura macro, a iluminação de flash direto e o estilo visual saturado e nítido característico da publicidade de suplementos e cosméticos de luxo dessa década.
 Create a high-end 1990s commercial luxury product photography poster.
Subject:
A hyper-realistic macro shot of a single, vibrant red raspberry. The fruit must show exquisite detail: tiny hairs (trichomes), individual drupelets with a glossy, moist sheen, and deep crimson textures. Resting on and around the raspberry are large, geometric, sharp-edged translucent salt crystals with a pyramidal structure.
Scene & Composition:
The composition is a centered, vertical product shot. The background is a clean, minimalist off-white with a subtle cool-toned vignette. Floating in the background are out-of-focus, ghost-like silhouettes of the same salt crystals to create depth.
Lighting & Camera:
Shot on a 100mm macro lens, f/8 for deep clarity. Lighting is a harsh, high-contrast direct studio flash that creates sharp specular highlights on the moist surface of the fruit and internal reflections within the crystals. 
Color & Tone:
- Color Grading: Aggressive 90s advertising saturation. 
- Palette: Deep "Vibrant Red" vs. "Crystalline White" vs. "Cool Gray/Cyan" shadows.
- Finish: High-gloss, punchy contrast, and zero film grain for a "pristine" commercial look.
Typography Overlay:
Centrally placed, vertical thin sans-serif white text reading "2000MG High-Impact Electrolytes" enclosed in a subtle pill-shaped border, with a clean, high-end editorial layout.
Overall Vibe: 
Surgical precision, refreshing, luxury performance, and bold 90s health-tech aesthetic.
 Destaques do Estilo: 
 Color Grading: Focado na saturação seletiva do vermelho (raspberry) para evocar "sabor" e "impacto", contrastando com sombras frias. 
 Iluminação: O uso de flash direto simula a fotografia de estúdio pré-digital, onde o brilho do produto era o foco principal. 
 Textura: Ênfase macro para captar detalhes que parecem "maiores que a vida", uma marca registrada de campanhas de suplementos premium.
